title: Find the misalignments stays quiet on busy app screenshots and is scored on real captures
goal: On a busy screenshot of a Mac app (selection handles, inspectors, toolbars) the misalignment check still marks things nobody would call a fault, and its scores come only from small web pages. Collect real captures with known faults and bring false marks on them to at most one per picture.
notes: Seen 2026-10-20: MisalignmentScan on app-window-2x.png marks the top middle selection handle (996,928 21x14 px) as Top edge 4 pt off. Reproduce: Scripts/playtest.sh with a walk opening that file and asking find the misalignments (see the audit walks in queue/audits/2026-10-20-find-misalignments.json), or run MisalignmentScan.findings on it. Corpus: Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/Fixtures/misalign, Scripts/misalign-corpus/make-corpus.mjs.
acceptance: At least ten real Mac app or website captures with their faults written down join the corpus test
No more than one false mark on any of them
The selection-handle false mark on Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/Fixtures/app-window-2x.png is gone
